articles.author: Matthew Petti
articles.summary: Russia had its infamous " three-day special military operation " in Ukraine. America now has its " short-term excursion " into Iran. In February 2026, when he chose to start the war, President Donald Trump promised the public that it would last only " four or five weeks " and promised other leaders that it would be won in three to four days . Now the world is approaching month seven of the on-again, off-again conflict. In a déjà vu moment, Trump recited his favorite talking points to Axios on Thursday: A "big decision" is coming soon, and he might "annihilate" Iran, but the Iranian leadership wants a deal very badly. articles.summary: Ella Beatty in Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story —Netflix This article discusses the full season of Netflix’s Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story is about female rage and repression. That isn’t my personal interpretation of the latest installment of Ian Brennan and Ryan Murphy ’s Netflix true-crime anthology . It’s the talking point that the show’s makers have been leading with, in publicity materials and in multiple interviews . These are fine themes for the first season of Monster with a female subject, even if they’re not exactly unique within a post- Big-Little-Lies , #MeToo-informed TV landscape where so many dramas aimed at women double as amplifiers for gendered frustrations. The well of misogyny isn’t in danger of running dry anytime soon. But if we must keep diving into it, each descent should at least leave us with some new insight or nuance. Lizzie Borden , now streaming, fails to clear even that bar.
